import pathlib,json,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
refs=[pathlib.Path(p) for p in ['products/reviews/shopify-reproduction-review.json','products/reviews/catalogue-agency-offer-independent/evidence.json','products/reviews/catalogue-agency-offer/source-inspection.json','products/reviews/catalogue-input-suitability/review.json','products/reviews/catalogue-qa-dupimg/evidence.json']]
texts={str(p):p.read_text() for p in refs if p.is_file()}
rows=[]
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file() or p.name=='index.html': continue
 h=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); matches=[]
 for name,text in texts.items():
  start=0
  while True:
   i=text.find(h,start)
   if i<0: break
   matches.append({'source':name,'context':text[max(0,i-500):min(len(text),i+700)]});start=i+len(h)
 rows.append({'path':str(p),'sha256':h,'historical_contexts':matches})
result={'inventory':rows,'missing_reference_files':[str(p) for p in refs if not p.is_file()],'limitation':'Hash occurrences require contextual review; this report is not an approval or deployment receipt.'}
out=pathlib.Path('products/reviews/catalogue-qa-example/inventory-contexts.json');out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print(out.read_text())
